basic_profile.bio: A seasoned software developer with a passion for Roman history and motorbikes. Based in Seattle, I work as a senior software engineer at a tech startup. When I'm not coding, you can find me riding my Aprilia motorcycle through the mountains or immersing myself in ancient Roman texts. I enjoy a good podcast from Maximum Fun and like to unwind with a few episodes before bed. Typically online in the evenings and weekends, I also contribute to open-source projects and provide mentorship for aspiring developers. Currently single and enjoying the freedom it brings.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science from the University of Washington and have over a decade of experience in the tech industry. My expertise lies in software development, with a focus on backend systems and cloud infrastructure. I am an avid learner, staying up-to-date with the latest in technology through continuous education and self-study.
